name: scroll-animation-cli
description: The scroll-animation skill's repository: the runtime pack lives in skills/scroll-animation/. The CLI ships from here at v2.

scripts.pretest: mkdir -p tests/.scratch tests/smoke-gsap/public && ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc=size=640x360:rate=30:duration=2" -g 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p tests/.scratch/clip.mp4 && cp tests/.scratch/clip.mp4 tests/smoke-gsap/public/clip.mp4
scripts.test: npm run test:types && npm run test:unit && npm run test:audit && npm run test:smoke && npm run generate:check && npm run test:cli
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.core.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.motion.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.gsap.json
